missing: A tested head-to-head of sub-$150 options (AeroFit 2, Nothing Ear (Open), Aeroclip, Acefast) on sound, fit, leakage and battery, plus current street prices and sale prices for pricier models like Shokz OpenFit 2.
why: Two major reviewers (Guardian, SoundGuys) answer with budget picks, and both point toward the Soundcore AeroFit 2. But most roundups lead with $180–$300 models and give little on sub-$150 tradeoffs. That leaves it short of saturated.
